{n} has started a wedding Pinterest board. It has 400 pins.
We've been engaged for {e} years, {n} said. "At this point it's not an engagement, it's a hostage situation."
{n} said, "My family keeps asking when the wedding is. I keep making up dates."
{n} took off the ring and put it on the table. "Plan the wedding, or I'm giving this back."
{n} said, "I'm not going to be engaged forever. Either we do this, or we don't."
{n} said, "I'll hold you to that."
{n} sighed. "Okay. Soon."
{n} gave you a long look. "You said that last time."
{n} went quiet for the rest of the night.

{n} looked like you'd slapped {him}.
{n} said, "Then what have we been doing all this time?"
{n} started crying.

First Day in the Building
Fresh out of OTC, {name} walks into the compound. Nobody salutes, nobody says hi. A guy with a beard points at an empty locker. What will you do?
Quietly unpack and observe
You kept your mouth shut. An old operator nodded at you. That is basically a hug here.
You won a few smiles. One guy even remembered your name.
They nicknamed you "Cruise Director." It will stick for years.
The Long Walk Flashback
compass
You wake at 0300 sweating, dreaming you are still on the Long Walk in West Virginia with a 45 lb ruck and no idea of the time limit. What will you do?
Go for a 5 a.m. ruck anyway
You walked it off. The Appalachians are still in your knees.
Roll over and sleep
You remembered you passed. Nobody can take that away. You slept like a rock.
Haircut Order? None.
helmet
For the first time in your career, nobody cares about your hair. {buddy} bets you can't grow a beard by the next deployment. What will you do?
Take the bet
Your beard came in thick and terrifying. {buddy} paid up.
Your beard came in patchy. You look like a substitute teacher. {buddy} took your money.
Keep it high and tight
You stayed clean-cut. In a foreign airport, you look exactly like a soldier. Not ideal.
Mom Asks What You Do
Your mom calls and asks what your new job is. The answer is classified. She sounds hurt. What will you tell her?
Paperwork. Very boring.
You lied for her own good. She bought it. Mostly.
Hint at "special stuff"
She got the hint and promised never to ask again.
She told her book club. The security office called you in for a chat.
Shoot House Mistake
In the shoot house you clear your corner but put two rounds into a "no-shoot" target holding a phone. The cadre is staring. What will you do?
Own it immediately
You admitted the mistake. The cadre respected that more than the miss.
Blame the lighting
Nobody here accepts excuses. You ran the house twenty more times that night.
Free Hit at the Range
Ammo here seems unlimited. You could shoot until your hands bleed or go home early for once. What will you do?
Shoot 2,000 more rounds
Your split times dropped. Your thumbs are raw hamburger.
Go home on time
You had dinner with real humans. Novel experience.
Civilian Cover Clothes
policeman
You are told to blend in overseas. You own exactly one outfit: cargo shorts, Oakleys, and a tactical belt. What will you do?
Ask {buddy} for fashion help
{buddy} took you shopping. You now own jeans with no extra pockets.
Wear the Oakleys anyway
Somehow nobody noticed. Lucky.
A street kid yelled "AMERICAN SOLDIER!" before you even left the airport.
The Breacher Course
You are slotted for advanced breaching. The instructor wants someone to stand closer than feels reasonable to "feel the charge." What will you do?
The blast rattled your teeth but you learned exactly how much is too much.
Your ears rang for a week. Mild TBI flagged by medical.
Let someone else go first
You watched and learned. Smart, but quiet guys notice who hangs back.
Pickup Truck Payday
Your special pay hits. You have never had this much money. A dealership has a lifted truck with your name on it. What will you do?
Buy the truck
It is gorgeous. It also costs more than your car insurance and rent combined.
Max out your TSP
Future you will be grateful. Present you drives a 2009 Corolla.
Airborne Refresher Fail
On a freefall refresher, your altimeter reads wrong and you are not sure of your altitude. What will you do?
Pull high and safe
You opened early and drifted away from the group. Embarrassing but alive.
Trust your eyes and wait
You read the ground perfectly and landed right on the X.
You pulled late, had a hard opening and broke your ankle on landing.
Old Timer's War Story
A grizzled operator corners you at the team room fridge and starts a story that begins in 1993. It is 1900 on Friday. What will you do?
Listen to the whole thing
Two hours later, you learned more than in all of OTC.
You escaped. He knows you faked it.
First Real Raid
Your first raid on a high-value target in {country}. You are third man in the stack. The door is about to blow. What will you do?
Follow the plan exactly
Textbook. Target captured, zero shots fired. You barely remember any of it.
A guard fired through a wall. Shrapnel caught your thigh. Your first Purple Heart.
Push past and take point
You moved fast and it worked. The team leader is annoyed but impressed.
You broke the flow. Nobody got hurt but the debrief was brutal.
Social Media Temptation
Your cousin tags you in a photo from the gym with the caption "my brother the secret agent lol." What will you do?
Ask cousin to delete it
It is gone. Your cousin thinks you are paranoid. You are paid to be.
Nobody noticed. This time.
Security found it. You spent a week scrubbing your digital life with a very unamused officer.
You are offered six months of language school before your next rotation. It means less trigger time. What will you do?
Take the language course
You can now order coffee and interrogate a suspect in a second language.
Stay on the line
You kept shooting. Someone else got the slot.
The Kill House Prank
{buddy} swaps your practice target for a cutout of your team sergeant. You hit it twice in the face. What will you do?
Everybody laughed, including the team sergeant. Eventually.
You glitter-bombed {buddy}'s kit bag. Legendary.
The glitter got in a sensitive item. The sergeant major was not amused.
Can't Tell Your Girlfriend
Your partner asks why you vanished for three weeks with no phone. "Training" is wearing thin. What will you do?
Stick to "training"
She accepted it, but you can tell she is keeping score.
She ended it. "I can't date a ghost," she said.
Bring her to a family day
Meeting the other spouses helped. She gets it now, without knowing anything.
You are trying to keep up with a 42-year-old operator who deadlifts like a hydraulic press. Your back is already twitching. What will you do?
Match his weight
You pulled it. He grunted. That counts as approval.
Your lower back seized. Two weeks with a physical therapist named Brenda.
Lift your own program
You stayed healthy. Ego bruised, spine intact.
You must follow a "target" across a city without being made. He just stopped and turned around. What will you do?
Duck into a coffee shop
He scanned right past you. You also got a decent latte.
He walked in behind you and said "Hi." Fail.
Keep walking past him
Bold. He never suspected the guy who walked right past.
You made eye contact for too long. Burned.
The Unit lets you pick most of your own kit. A buddy recommends a brand-new optic nobody has tested in combat. What will you do?
Stick with proven gear
Boring and reliable. Exactly what you want at 2 a.m. in a hallway.
Try the shiny new optic
It is incredible. Half the troop copies you.
It fogged up on the first cold night. You shot iron sights and swore a lot.
Hostage Rescue Exercise
In a full-scale hostage rescue drill on a mock airliner, a role-player "hostage" bolts toward you. What will you do?
Control and flex-cuff him
Correct. Everyone is a threat until proven otherwise.
Wave him past you
He was the hijacker. Your team was "killed." Long debrief.
Paycheck Side Hustle
A "tactical influencer" offers you $2,000 to appear in a gun video, face blurred, no unit mentioned. What will you do?
You declined. Quiet professionals stay quiet.
Do the video
Nobody figured it out. You feel a little dirty anyway.
Your distinctive tattoo gave you away. NJP and a lecture you will never forget.
Ambush on the Road
Your convoy of unmarked vehicles in {country} gets hit by an IED and small arms. Your vehicle is on fire. What will you do?
Drag the driver out
You pulled him through flames under fire. Bronze Star with V.
You got him out but took burns on both arms.
Return fire from cover
You suppressed the ambush until the team broke contact.
Too Many Energy Drinks
stethoscope
You have had six energy drinks during a 30-hour mission planning cycle. Your heart is doing drum solos. What will you do?
See the medic
The medic made you drink water and lie down. Embarrassing but fine.
Have a seventh
You survived. You also saw sounds for a while.
Heart palpitations put you in the hospital for observation.
Evasive driving course: you must J-turn a sedan at speed. The instructor promises it is "basically safe." What will you do?
Perfect 180. You want to do this for a living now.
You rolled it. The roll cage worked. Your neck did not.
Go easy on the first try
Clean but slow. The instructor yawned.
Overseas Bar Fight
swords
On a training trip abroad, a drunk local shoves {buddy} at a bar. You are in civilian cover. What will you do?
Pull {buddy} out of there
You left before it escalated. Cover intact.
Knock the guy out
One punch, then you vanished. Nobody filed a report.
Police got involved. An embassy official had to bail you out. Huge mess.
Selection Nightmare Buddy
A guy you went through Selection with, who quit on day 20, calls asking how to try again. What will you do?
Coach him on land nav
You spent weekends with him in the woods. He feels ready.
Tell him you can't discuss it
Technically correct. He thinks you got arrogant.
The recce troop needs a new sniper. The pipeline is long and brutal, and you would leave your assault team. What will you do?
Try out for recce
You made it. You can now hit a dinner plate at 1,000 yards.
You washed out on the stalk. Back to the assault team.
Stay an assaulter
{buddy} is glad you stayed.
Night Vision Fall
Under NODs on a rooftop in {country}, you lose depth perception near a ledge. What will you do?
Stop and check footing
You froze for a second and felt the edge with your boot. Smart.
Keep moving with the team
You kept pace and the target was secured.
You stepped off a 12-foot roof. Broken wrist, cracked ribs.
Gift From a Partner Force
A partner-force commander gifts you an ornate dagger after a joint op. Accepting gifts is a gray area. What will you do?
Report it to the legal team
Legal logged it. It hangs in the team room now.
Quietly keep it
Nobody asked. It looks great on your shelf.
An inventory audit found it. Paperwork, NJP and a lot of explaining.
Freefall Over the Desert
HALO infiltration at 25,000 feet over {country}. Your oxygen mask starts leaking at exit. What will you do?
Signal and dump altitude fast
You tracked hard and stayed conscious. Landed on target.
Hypoxia made you loopy. You landed 3 km off and twisted a knee.
Ignore it and push on
It held enough. Close call.
killed by hypoxia during a HALO jump
You blacked out. Your AAD fired your reserve. You woke in a field, alive by luck.
Volunteer Tryout Day
You are asked to be a role-player for current Selection candidates. You could make their lives miserable. What will you do?
Play it straight
You gave them a fair, hard test. The cadre appreciated it.
Mess with them a little
One candidate will remember your fake accent for the rest of his life.
Phone in the Kill Zone
satellite
Before a sensitive op, you realize your personal phone is still in your pocket. Location services are on. What will you do?
Confess and hand it over
Embarrassing, but the comms guy caught it before step-off. Lesson learned.
Turn it off and hope
Nothing happened. Your heart rate did, though.
It pinged a tower. The op was scrubbed. You were busted down a grade.
Team Leader Promotion
You are offered team leader of a four-man element. It means more planning and less time with your rifle. What will you do?
Accept the job
You are now responsible for three lives besides your own. Heavy.
Stay a shooter
You stayed in the stack. Simple life.
Running Selection Cadre
You are cadre for Assessment & Selection in West Virginia. A candidate is clearly hurt but refuses to quit. What will you do?
Pull him for medical
He hated you. The doctor found a stress fracture. You were right.
Let him keep walking
He finished. He will be a legend someday.
He collapsed on the trail with rhabdo. Investigation.
{buddy} is showing up smelling like whiskey after the last rotation. Nobody has said anything. What will you do?
Talk to him privately
He broke down and agreed to see the embedded psych. You may have saved his career.
He told you to mind your business. Things are tense now.
He got help, but he knows it was you.
It is not your business. Until it is.
Terrorists hold six aid workers in a compound in {country}. You lead the assault team. Intel is thin. What will you do?
Stealth entry at 0300
All six hostages walked out. Every captor is down. Silver Star.
A sentry spotted you. Hostages saved, but you took a round through the shoulder.
Wait for better intel
Two days later, a drone confirmed positions and the rescue went clean. You barely slept.
New Guy Is Struggling
A new operator on your team keeps hesitating in the shoot house. The troop sergeant major asks your opinion. What will you do?
Ask for time to mentor him
Two months of extra reps and he is now one of the fastest on the team.
He still froze on a real op. He was quietly sent back to the regular Army.
Recommend he be released
Brutal but honest. Standards are standards.
Book Deal Offer
A New York publisher offers $400,000 for your memoir about the Unit. Security review would gut half of it. What will you do?
The team respects you for it. The money stings a little.
Write it and submit for review
Approved after redactions. You are rich and a little shunned.
Review dragged on for two years. Publisher walked.
Publish without review
Somehow nobody sued. Your former teammates do not return calls.
Unauthorized disclosure of classified information
The government seized your profits and court-martialed you.
Your troop hits a bomb-maker's safe house in {country}. He is running out the back toward a car. What will you do?
Tackle him
You took him down in the dirt. Intelligence windfall. Bronze Star.
You got him but he had a knife. Twelve stitches in your forearm.
Shoot the tires
The car went nowhere. He surrendered.
Family Dinner Silence
flag
At Thanksgiving, your uncle asks if you "killed anybody over there." Everyone goes quiet. What will you do?
You asked about his fantasy football team. Crisis averted.
Leave the table
You sat in the truck for 20 minutes. Your wife brought you pie.
Tell him off
He will never ask again. Your mom is mortified.
During a live-fire exercise, a ricochet hits {buddy} in the leg. Blood is pumping. What will you do?
Apply a tourniquet now
Your tourniquet saved his life. ARCOM for quick action.
He lived but lost the leg. You replay it every night.
Wait for the medic
The medic got there in time, barely. You froze. You know it.
You come home from an 8-month rotation to find divorce papers on the counter. What will you do?
Fight for the marriage
Counseling worked. You are both trying.
It did not work. She got the house.
Sign them
You signed. The Unit is your family now. That is the problem.
Rival Unit Beef
A Navy SEAL team gets credit for a target your troop found and fixed. The press release names them. What will you do?
Quiet professionals. You know what you did.
Complain to JSOC
JSOC quietly corrected the record internally.
You came off as petty. The general said "We are all on the same team."
Your team is pinned on a rooftop in {country} by an RPK on the next building. Two men are hit. What will you do?
Assault across the roofs
You jumped the gap and silenced the gun. Silver Star.
killed by machine gun fire on a rooftop
You were hit mid-jump.
Call in the AC-130
Spooky erased the building. Your guys got medevaced.
The gunship was delayed. One of your wounded died.
Your team wants matching tattoos with a skull and the troop's call sign. It could identify you overseas. What will you do?
Veto it
They grumbled. They also stay unidentifiable.
Get the ink
It looks fantastic. The intel guys sighed.
Partner Force Abuse
You see partner-force soldiers in {country} beating a detainee after a raid. They outnumber your team. What will you do?
Intervene and report it
You stopped it and filed the report. The partner commander is furious. You sleep fine.
You told yourself it was not your fight. It haunts you.
recycle
Fifteenth rotation. You cannot remember the last time you felt anything. The psych offers you a break. What will you do?
Take six months off
You fished, slept, and laughed. You feel human again.
You kept going. Your wife says you are a stranger.
The Selection Rumor
A cadre member tells you Selection standards are being "adjusted" to pass more people. What will you do?
Push back through channels
Your concerns were heard. Standards held.
You got the "stay in your lane" talk.
Not your call. You just hope the next guy is good.
Gear Sergeant Feud
The supply guy says your team's night vision upgrade is "backordered" while another troop got theirs. What will you do?
Bring him a case of beer
Your NODs magically appeared Monday.
Someone saw. Gift to supply personnel = paperwork.
Escalate to the sergeant major
You got them in three weeks and lost a friend in supply.
A captured bomb-maker in {country} smirks and says there is another device ticking. Your team wants to "persuade" him. What will you do?
Hand him to interrogators
The professionals got the location by playing nice. The device was disarmed.
Rough him up
He talked. You feel sick about it.
Maltreatment of a detainee
general
He reported abuse. A JAG investigation ended your career.
Old Injury Flares
Your spine is fused at two levels. The surgeon says one more hard jump could paralyze you. A big op is next week. What will you do?
Hide it and go
You made it through. Your back screamed for a month.
You landed wrong. Months of rehab.
Dead Buddy's Kids
{buddy} was killed last year. His widow asks if you can teach his son to fish this summer. What will you do?
Show up every weekend
The kid laughs like his dad. It hurts and heals at the same time.
Send money instead
You could not face it. The check helped, but she noticed.
Range Safety Shortcut
The range is behind schedule. Someone suggests skipping the final explosive safety check to make the window. What will you do?
Do the full check
Finished late. Nobody died. Good day.
It worked out. You got lucky.
A misfire cooked off near you. Wounded, and a safety investigation found your shortcut.
Team Room Gambling
A poker game in the team room has gotten serious. One guy is down $8,000. What will you do?
The team grumbled but money problems kill clearances.
Join the game
You cleaned house. Everybody hates you a little.
You lost your truck payment. And then some.
Plane Hijacking Alert
A real airliner is seized at a European airport. Your squadron spins up. You are on the first bird out. What will you do?
Lead the assault on the aircraft
You entered through the over-wing exits. 140 passengers lived. Bronze Star.
A hijacker fired once. You stopped him, but the round found you.
Cover the exterior
You held the perimeter while the assault went in clean.
Old Friend From Ranger Batt
A buddy from your Ranger days asks you to vouch for him at Selection. He is decent, not great. What will you do?
Give an honest reference
He did not get in. He is still your friend. Mostly.
Hype him up
He made it and proved you right.
He quit on day 3. Your judgment is now in question.
You keep dreaming about a doorway in {country} where things went wrong. You are snapping at your kids. What will you do?
See a therapist
It is slow, but you are sleeping again.
Drink it away
It works for an hour. Then it really does not.
Media Leak Suspect
A journalist publishes details of your last op. Investigators ask who on your team talks to reporters. You have a suspicion. What will you do?
Share your suspicion
